pages.title: Configuring Effects
pages.text: All nutrition effects are defined in $(thing)config/nourished/effects.json$(). This file is created automatically on first launch with sensible defaults.$(br2)You can change which nutrients trigger which effects, adjust thresholds and durations, add entirely new effects, or disable any existing ones — all without touching any code.

pages.title: Effect Triggers
pages.text: Effects support the following trigger types:$(br2)$(li)$(thing)below$() — fires when a nutrient drops below a threshold$(li)$(thing)above$() — fires when a nutrient exceeds a threshold$(li)$(thing)all_above$() — fires when ALL nutrients exceed a threshold$(li)$(thing)any_below$() — fires when ANY nutrient drops below a threshold$(li)$(thing)between$() — fires when a nutrient is within a range
